title: Computer Vision: Algorithms and Applications (2nd Edition)
annotation: Buku rujukan kanonikal internasional. Bab 2 dan 3 menyajikan pemodelan sistem koordinat, matriks transformasi 2D/3D, dan teknik warping citra.

title: Multiple View Geometry in Computer Vision (2nd Edition)
annotation: Karya ilmiah rujukan utama dunia mengenai geometri proyektif, ruang koordinat homogen P^2/P^3, dan estimasi matriks homografi.

title: Digital Image Processing (4th Edition)
authors: Rafael C. Gonzalez, Richard E. Woods
annotation: Bab 2 menyajikan penjelasan mendalam mengenai interpolasi nearest-neighbor, bilinear, dan bicubic pada transformasi spasial citra.
